TRADE STANDARDS

What Happens After Your Inquiry

01

Technical Feasibility Review

Our quality control desk verifies current inventory stock, screen size distributions, and cupping lab availability against your request.

02

Formal Spot Offer & Incoterms

You receive a comprehensive pro-forma quotation specifying FOB Mombasa or CIF destination port pricing, container stuffing timeline, and payment milestones.

03

Pre-Shipment Sample Dispatch

For approved commercial buyers, representative 300g to 500g green coffee samples are packaged in moisture barrier bags and sent via express courier.
